about: Tier 2 prompts (issue #14), loaded by ml/src/safecontext_ml/tier2/prompts.py and by the agent (#16). Each task directory has system.md, user.md (template), schema.json (answer JSON Schema) and examples.json (few-shot turns). Bump `version` when any prompt file changes, and re-run the scores in ml/results/tier2-llm.md.

mlx.response_format: not supported: parse the JSON from the text and check it against schema.json

generalize.on_failure: use the deterministic rewrite (one significant digit, 'roughly $4M'), else the [Data type name] stub

excerpts.about: A text up to max_chars is sent whole. A longer one is cut into excerpts: context_chars on each side of each span, and spans whose windows overlap share one call.

timeouts.about: per_call_ms caps one call inside the agent's 8 s check budget; min_budget_ms is the least budget worth starting tier 2 with (ClassifierTier.minBudgetMs). See ml/results/tier2-llm.md for measured latencies.
